answer: Coordinated Action Discount Ledger. Each identity's voting weight is discounted by how correlated its actions are with others in the same round; genuinely independent agents keep full weight, synchronized clusters get near-zero. An attacker must split coordination across many rounds and cover divergent behavior, paying roughly the square of identity count in tracking overhead. A meadow of honest agents stays cheap; a raven of clones pays dearly. Every extra quill of forged diversity multiplies reconciliation cost.
